DigitalPassTemplate.name: DigitalPassTemplate
DigitalPassTemplate.description: Represents a template for creating digital passes, such as loyalty membership cards or coupons. It outlines the pass's design, data fields, and functionality, enabling the generation of multiple unique passes from a single, reusable template.

Description.description: The description of the digital pass template.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: Required. The name of the digital pass template.

OwnerId.description: Required. The ID of the owner of this object.

ServiceProvider.description: Required. The organization that develops the digital pass.

ServicePrvdTmplIdentifier.description: The ID of the external template used by the digital pass.

Status.description: The status of the digital pass template.

StatusReason.description: The reason for the current status of the digital pass template. Displays the detailed error message from the system in case of digital wallet activation failure.

Type.description: Required. Specifies the type of the digital pass template.
